Write data to a Google Sheet

Source: R/gsheet.R
write_gsheet.Rd

Writes data with write_xlsx() and uploads the file to Google Drive, which converts it to a Google Sheet, keeping the facade styling (merged headers, borders, fonts and fills). Requires the googledrive package; sign in with googledrive::drive_auth().

Usage

write_gsheet(data, path, ...)

Arguments

data

A tsg table or a list of them, as for write_xlsx().

path

Where to write. A name or Drive path (e.g. "reports/Table 1") creates a new Google Sheet. An existing sheet, given as googledrive::as_id("<file id>") or a dribble, has its contents replaced in place, so its link stays the same.

...

Arguments passed to write_xlsx(), e.g. facade or include_table_list. separate_files = TRUE is not supported. With include_table_list = TRUE, the links of the table list are rewritten after the upload so they open the right tab in Google Sheets.

Value

Invisibly, the Google Sheet as a googledrive::dribble.

Details

Signing in needs access to your Drive files: on Google's consent screen, tick the box to see, edit, create and delete your Google Drive files (it is unticked by default). Without it, writing fails with "(403) Forbidden: Request had insufficient authentication scopes"; sign in again with googledrive::drive_auth(scopes = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive", cache = FALSE) and tick the box.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
googledrive::drive_auth()
sheet <- write_gsheet(generate_frequency(person_record, sex), "Sex distribution")

# Replace the contents of the same sheet later; its link stays the same
write_gsheet(generate_frequency(person_record, marital_status), sheet)
} # }
